function: Extrapolates channel fingerprints (statistical CSI, beam-domain power angular spectrum maps) from one frequency band to another for multi-band massive MIMO; p. 1, p. 5.
system: Multi-antenna BS UPAs (8x8 at f1, 10x10 to 15x15 at f2), single-antenna UT, no RIS; f1 2/2.45 GHz, f2 3.6-24 GHz; p. 3, 8.
method: Pair of cycle-consistent generative CNNs (encoder, residual blocks, decoder) with variable-weight cycle loss; supervised paired MSE joint training with Adam; p. 5-7.
data_channel: QuaDRiGa-generated LOS and NLOS datasets, 32x32 m region, 2 m grids, 364 time slots per grid, PAS from covariance eigenvalues; simulated; p. 8.
test_conditions: Training and testing datasets from QuaDRiGa (p. 9); results swept over LOS/NLOS, f2 3.6/5/24 GHz and M2 10x10-15x15; no train-test condition mismatch stated; p. 9-11.
baselines: Non-learned: linear extrapolation from spatial correlation matrices [66]. Learned: CycleGAN-based CF extrapolation [56]; ablations without cycle loss and without refining; p. 9-10.
metrics: NMSE of extrapolated CF (Eq. 28, p. 9; Tables III-V, Figs. 5-6); downlink sum rate with robust precoding versus ideal-CSI upper bound (Fig. 7, p. 12).
complexity: Table VI: 126.47 M parameters, 5.71 G FLOPs, 29.65 MB memory, 3.69 s inference time; convolutional time-complexity order given; p. 12.
openness: none; no code or data link found in the paper (p. 8 only cites QuaDRiGa as simulator).
q1_support: p. 8: "The datasets are generated by QuaDRiGa [60]"; QuaDRiGa is a listed standard model.
q2_support: p. 9: "we conduct experiments to evaluate the NMSE performance with different numbers of antennas and various frequencies"; not met: no model trained under one condition is stated to be tested under another, and the network input size follows the antenna count (p. 8: input tensors 32 x 32 x 100 and 32 x 32 x 64).
q3_support: p. 9: "linear extrapolation-based method [66] and CycleGAN-based algorithm [56] are adopted as benchmarks"; both compared on NMSE (Table IV, p. 10) and sum rate (Fig. 7, p. 12).
q4_support: p. 12: "Table VI gives the specific numerical results of indicators like parameters, floating point operations (FLOPs), memories"; Table VI lists 126.47 M parameters, 5.71 G FLOPs, 3.69 s inference.
q5_support: p. 8: "The datasets are generated by QuaDRiGa [60]"; not met: the paper gives no link to code or to its generated data, and a simulator-generated dataset is not a public channel dataset.
notes: Area 2 chosen because the learned method predicts statistical CSI (beam-domain PAS) maps across bands, not positioning or spectrum prediction; sum rate is checked with robust precoding built from the extrapolated PAS (p. 11-12). Table I (p. 8) lists f2 = 3.9 GHz but the text of p. 10-11 says 3.6 GHz. q2 is borderline: the f2 and M2 sweeps are called generalization (p. 9) but no cross-condition test is stated.
